item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Yellow Pig
  • 発売日: 2006-07-28
  • スコア: 7.209999999999999/10 (86 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夫の前で犯されて・・・
  • 英語名: Otto no Mae de Okasarete…

别名

  • Otto no Mae de Okasarete…

あらすじ

Akizuki Shouta and Akizuki Chihiro happily live their first year since wedding. Shouta is a government worker at the city hall, but due to his timidness, he is often pestered by his boss, Zama Yuusaku. And Chihiro is the one who supports mentally and phisically stressed Shouta. One day Yuusaku came to the Akizuki house to mock newly-married life of his subordinate. But his initial intension changed after seeing the beautiful Chihiro. Irritated that such woman married guy who can`t even properly do his job, Yuusaku starts weaving plans for getting Chihiro for his own.
